summary.title: Part 03 — 19 November 1965: Ronald Melzack & Patrick Wall's Gate Control Theory of Pain — Midpoint Twist

plates.quality_reason: Quality: readable faces (Canadian psychologist Ronald Melzack and British neuroscientist Patrick David Wall at MIT on 19 November 1965 publishing the Gate Control Theory of Pain in Science, showing how fast A-beta touch fibres excite substantia gelatinosa inhibitory interneurons in the spinal dorsal horn to block slow C pain fibres).
